title_zh: 确认主席空缺期间的会议主持人

scenario.label_zh: 确认社团主席辞职后的临时会议主持人
scenario.goal_zh: 确认社团主席职位空缺并约定由副主席主持临时会议

context_zh: 业余摄影社团秘书 Lena 与副主席 Victor 核对已收到的辞职信及临时会议安排。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: We've received Ada's resignation, so the club presidency is vacant.

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: Does our handbook say who should preside at the meeting tonight?

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Yes. The vice-chair takes that role while the members arrange an election.

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: That's me, then. I'll chair tonight's discussion, but I'm not taking over as permanent president.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Exactly. I'll put the election arrangements on the agenda.

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: Please do. I'll open the meeting by explaining the temporary arrangement.
